values.goal: Reconcile terminal GitHub truth and provide a separate, path-exact, fail-closed cleanup operation.
values.required_outcome: terminal GitHub truth dirty-worktree rejection and second-run no-op is produced at an exact revision and independently reproducible.
declared_scope: `finish`, linkage-aware PR selection, merged/closed/checkpoint/no-PR outcomes, terminal receipts, projection reconciliation, `clean` classify/preview/remove, canonical worktree identity, dirty/live/drift predicates, and retained evidence.
authority_boundary: Issue V3-15 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
Keep evidence producer-derived and exact-revision bound
